question:
**Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error. **

The elegance furnished drawing room indicated that the owner had good taste.
solution:
The erroneous part is **'The elegance furnished'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here,** 'the elegantly furnished' **should be used instead of **'the elegance furnished'.**
